prompt_en: Photorealistic neutral textile-catalog environmental editorial in a 4:5 frame, natural eye-level three-quarter to full figure. Feature one unmistakably adult woman, about 30, in a decommissioned coastal cable-car terminal built into a sea cliff after rain. Image 1 supplies general visible appearance guidance for a new original adult model: long dark center-parted wavy hair, softly defined brows, brown eyes, and restrained natural makeup; her facial identity remains original to this scene. Present her upright, self-directed, and task-focused as she plants one boot on the grated platform and pulls a waist-high red brake lever with both hands while an empty gondola rolls past the open portal; both hands, lever angle, and cabin motion read clearly together. She wears a revealing editorial outfit with opaque fabric covering her breasts and pelvis. Its base is an unmistakably opaque high-neck sleeveless column dress, fully lined from neckline through hips. Dry translucent organza forms sleeves, an upper yoke, and long overlay panels. Over this lined base, the sheer garment uses a translucent organza layer that remains visibly present as a textile; its visible weave seam and edge plus folded borders remain sharply legible. Coherent amber light passes through the fabric in one direction. The sheer overlay above an opaque base leaves the solid breast and pelvis panels fully covered. Overlapping folds become denser and less transparent while single layers transmit more light. Skin, lining, steel machinery, and clear air retain normal opacity and crisp detail. Balance the garment landmarks, functional action, wet machinery, gondola, and storm-dark ocean in one measured catalog frame.
